channel.title: SFWeather 94122 — NWS alerts & high-POP days
channel.description: Opt-in digest: NWS alerts for CAZ006 and days in the 7-day window with POP ≥ 50%. Opt-in only: subscribe with your own feed reader; this project stores no address, sends no email, and collects no personal data. The feed is a static file — subscription happens entirely between you and your reader.
